sourceCrs: EPSG:2326 HK1980 Grid -> EPSG:4326 WGS84 via pyproj
note: Real building envelopes from HK Lands Dept 6-NW-12D. Footprints are AABB rectangles (not surveyed polygons); heights are the mesh Y-axis maximum, not a measured floor count. The geometry is suitable for visual massing and AI-driven height edits.
